root_cause.text: In tls_do_encryption, when crypto_aead_encrypt() returns -EBUSY, the async callback tls_encrypt_done() already handles scatterlist restoration and decrement of encrypt_pending, but the synchronous error path after tls_encrypt_async_wait() repeats this cleanup, causing corruption that leads to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check to skip synchronous cleanup when the async wait returns an error (rc != -EINPROGRESS), because "the async callback tls_encrypt_done() has already decremented encrypt_pending and restored the sge". The CVE description confirms the double-decrement and double-restore corrupt the encrypt_pending sentinel, causing later use-after-free.

intent_record.intent_summary: Skip duplicate synchronous cleanup after async encryption completes via wait, fixing a double decrement of encrypt_pending and double sge restoration.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional block inside the async wait path that checks if rc is not -EINPROGRESS after tls_encrypt_async_wait, and if so, removes the record from the list and returns early, skipping the synchronous cleanup below.
intent_record.how: This prevents the synchronous cleanup code (which decrements encrypt_pending and restores sge) from executing when the async callback has already performed those actions, avoiding double decrement and double restoration on both success and error cases.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent directly matches the root cause: it addresses the duplicate cleanup (double decrement and double scatterlist restoration) that occurs when async encryption (via -EBUSY) has already handled cleanup but the synchronous error path repeats it.

candidates.rationale: This condition, after tls_encrypt_async_wait() returns 0 (success), evaluates true (since !0 is true) and thus enters the error path, performing duplicate cleanup (e.g., atomic_dec) that was already done by the async callback.
This decrement of encrypt_pending is executed in the error path after a successful async wait, causing a double decrement because the async callback tls_encrypt_done() already decremented it.
